headline: Chainflip confirmed that 122.86 BTC was stolen in addition to the Ethereum vault outflow previously estimated at $4.86 million. Microsoft confirmed exploitation of Entra Connect Health, and Cyber advised users to avoid its token bridge while it investigates unexpected minting.

incidents.what: Chainflip confirmed that Bitcoin was stolen in addition to ether and stablecoins, and offered a bounty for returning the funds.
Microsoft said a server-side flaw let an unauthorized party read administrator email addresses and tenant metadata, with no unauthorized configuration changes found.
CNN, AP and Fox News independently cited sources describing an apparent intrusion into the FBI’s national crime database; the FBI declined to comment to AP.
Germany’s Federal Employment Agency confirmed an attack on its separately run property-management systems and said it had no evidence that benefits-recipient data was affected.
Staples Canada said unauthorized access at its print website exposed contact information, order summaries and encrypted passwords.
incidents.scale: Count not disclosed; no financial data reported exposed

incidents.what: Cyber confirmed unexpected token minting on Solana and an outflow from its Ethereum bridge reserve, and told users to avoid the bridge and exchange deposits.
incidents.scale: About 5.21M CYBER moved; final loss unknown

incidents.what: Optimizely shut down a legacy deployment server and removed an injected script from two sites after finding unauthorized access.
Illinois disclosed an apparent intrusion attempt at the Algonquin Dam on the Fox River and said the dam continued to operate.
Eskenazi Health disclosed that patient information may have been accessed after two employee email accounts were compromised in September.
The Icelandic provider’s managing director said seven websites were destroyed in the attack and that services would return in phases.
GoFundMe confirmed some donor contact data was accessed and said Salesforce restored its software packages while the integration remained disabled.
DeFiChain said it expects to reverse the effects of its November exploit and deploy a fix in December, with no date yet for reopening affected wallet services.
